Write Fiction Like Great Movies
Explore the nuances of fictional stories and give yourself the power to craft stories that stay with readers long after the last word is read.
CTA BUTTON: Join the Waitlist

You have learned the basics, the terminologies, and definitions of the elements of fiction writing. Now, you’ll learn how to truly awaken the spirit of feverish, hypnotic, and lasting stories, as great screenwriters do.

This course is a work of reflective teaching, shaped by my journey—from writing my first journal in high school to studying theater as an undergraduate, from once running a story blog to writing two novels and a collection of poems, and from teaching storytelling to adult learners to relearning the craft through thoughtful critique and exposure to the finest works by today’s local and international creative minds.
It’s not a course on rules or strict methods of writing. Rather, it's an invitation to discover the creative thinking and craftsmanship that go into creating stories that truly stand out.
Course Modules
Recap: Elements of Fiction Writing

Language: Between Deeper Meanings and the Unseen and Unknown
Worlds & Motions: Giving Characters Sandboxes or Labyrinths
A Genius Writer's Playground: Voice, Style, Identity
A Writer Prepares: Research, Confidentiality, AI, and Other Weighty Matters
Questions and Answers on Craft and Productivity
Tryout: A Writing Adventure

What You’ll Walk Away With
Learn how to think like a genius writer and master your own voice and style as a storyteller.
Write fiction stories that bring readers back after their first read.
Create characters that readers become addicted to and remember long after they finish the story.
Learn how to manage your creative process and deal with productivity roadblocks.
What You Can Do After Taking the Course
Write a story you'll be proud to tell people about.
Launch out as a paid ghostwriter and earn well from writing for others.
Step up your writing journey with web series and build a loyal readership.
Go Pro: Turn your dusty ideas into stories for film or a YouTube channel series.
